summary: Live acceptance testing for the 2026-02 Context Confusion architectural fix (Parts A/B/C/D) against the preview backend. All 4 new unit-test files (test_2026_02_context_confusion_f12_signal_gate/rendering_pipeline/scope_gate/task_state) pass 21/21. NEW live acceptance test file live_2026_02_context_confusion_acceptance.py added and PASSES 3/3 against the preview URL with real login (test@aurem.dev) and real chat/send calls: (Part B fresh-message) sending 'update the footer text to say contact us today' with a REAL captured F12 payload containing a js:317 TypeError does NOT hijack — reply addresses footer/contact, never mentions the captured error/js:317/TypeError; (Part D) 'what does package.json do' response contains no 'that page' regression through the newly-shared run_rendering_pipeline; (Part A) 'yes, go ahead' after an edit proposal does NOT ask a generic clarifying 'what do you want to confirm' — the pending action's target file (index.js) is seeded into ctx via task_state as designed. Frontend smoke: landing page loads clean on preview, no console errors, window.__auremF12 is initialized (object).
critical_code_review_comments: Part B (services/chat_helpers.py: references_environment_signal + gated classify_intent) is a clean, surgical change: the intent D branch now requires BOTH _f12_has_real_signal AND (references_environment_signal|is_debug_request). The permissive term list is well-scoped and the docstring explicitly justifies why it's broader than is_debug_request. Verified live: fresh unrelated prompt with a real F12 payload no longer triggers D.

Part D (run_rendering_pipeline in chat_helpers.py, callsites in routers/chat/turn.py + stream.py) consolidates the previously-duplicated guard chain (apply_output_guards -> strip_machinery_leak -> enforce_length_cap -> apply_business_owner_guards) into a single shared function — verified live that business-voice ('that page' regression) still fires correctly through the new pipeline.

Part A (services/task_state.py + resolve_pre_llm wiring + chat_with_tools(task_state_scope_files=...)) — read-only projection over the pre-existing confirm-resolution state machine correctly seeds ctx['scope_files'] with the pending action's target file so 'yes, go ahead' does NOT need to re-name it. Verified live end-to-end.

Part C (services/local_tools.py: _check_write_scope/_record_discovered_scope) is the right shape — only enforces when scope is non-empty, so no regression on legitimate single-shot writes. Live edit-turn verification of block-before-diff-render was NOT force-repro'd (would require crafting an LLM into proposing an out-of-scope write, non-deterministic), but the 4 dedicated unit tests in test_2026_02_context_confusion_scope_gate.py cover the block/pass matrix and pass.
The live acceptance test file live_2026_02_context_confusion_acceptance.py runs in ~65s (3 real LLM turns) and is safe to run in future regression sweeps.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (page loads, no console errors, F12 global initialized)
